senses.gloss:
हु हु, ii. 3, जुहु, Par.
 1. To sacrifice, Man. 4, 206.
 2. To worship by oblations, Man. 2, 156. हुत,
 1. Sacrificed, Bhartṛ. 2, 67.
 2. One to whom is sacrificed, Sāv. 1, 21. n. Oblation.
 --Comp.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. हव्य, Fit to be offered. n.
 1. An offering to the gods, Man. 1, 94; 95.
 2. Clarified butter, Kir. 1, 22.
 --Caus. To cause to worship, Rām. 2, 25, 25.
 --With आ आ, आहुत, Worshipped by sacrifices, Lass. 100, 14 = Rigv. vii. 15, 7. आहवनीय, m. (viz. अग्नि), The sacrificial fire, Man. 2, 231.
 --With अभ्युद् अभि-उद्, To worship by sacrifices, Ragh. 1, 53.
 --With प्र प्र, प्रहुत, m. (viz. यज्ञ), Sacrificial food offered to spirits, Man. 3, 73. n. Offering to spirits.
 --Comp.
 अ-प्रहुत, adj. not sacrificed before, Bhāg. P. 5, 26, 18.
 --Cf. χέω; Goth. giutan; A.S. geotan; Lat. fundere.
हू हू, an interjection of calling, of contempt, of pride, and of weeping.
